entries.title: Sengoku Dynasty
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with latest updates

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with 2026 Shokunin update
primary.why: Sengoku Dynasty left PC Early Access in November 2024, later came to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S/Xbox PC in 2025, and has continued receiving content updates on all platforms. The PC route remains the best archive target for fidelity, capture, and settings, while current console builds are legitimate convenience routes with broad content parity.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC build with the latest update installed. Recheck console patch notes if using PS5 or Xbox for cross-platform co-op documentation.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with the highest capture/settings ceiling and ongoing update support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most controllable archive route.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen console release with optimized console support and post-1.0 content.
all_releases.reason: secondary: content-viable console route, but PC remains better for capture/settings.

all_releases.fidelity: Current-gen Xbox and Xbox PC route with Xbox Play Anywhere support.
all_releases.reason: secondary: content-viable console/Windows Store route, but PC storefront/capture remains the main archive path.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Publisher updates describe current content across PC and consoles; PC remains preferred for fidelity/capture rather than exclusive content.

entries.remaster_caveats: Bushido, Kanata, Sakura, and Shokunin are update/DLC-era content, not separate game entries. Recheck the current storefront before treating console parity as final.
